tools.name: receive_stock_shipment_line
tools.description: Adds received units to a SKU's on-hand quantity at a bin location and records a receiving entry. Returns the new on-hand quantity along with the previous quantity and any low-stock warning status.

params.name: sku
params.description: SKU code of the item received

params.name: bin_code
params.description: Bin location where the units were put away

params.name: po_number
params.description: Purchase order number associated with the receipt

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("warehouse-inventory")

DB_PATH = "warehouse.db"


@dataclass
class ReceiptResult:
    sku: str
    bin_code: str
    previous_quantity: int
    new_quantity: int
    below_reorder_point: bool
    success: bool
    message: str


@mcp.tool()
def receive_stock_shipment_line(sku: str, bin_code: str, quantity: int, po_number: str = "") -> ReceiptResult:
    if quantity <= 0:
        return ReceiptResult(sku, bin_code, 0, 0, False, False, "quantity must be positive")

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "SELECT quantity FROM stock WHERE sku = ? AND bin_code = ?",
            (sku, bin_code),
        )
        row = cur.fetchone()
        previous = row[0] if row else 0
        new_total = previous + quantity

        if row:
            cur.execute(
                "UPDATE stock SET quantity = ? WHERE sku = ? AND bin_code = ?",
                (new_total, sku, bin_code),
            )
        else:
            cur.execute(
                "INSERT INTO stock (sku, bin_code, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (sku, bin_code, new_total),
            )

        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO receiving_log (sku, bin_code, quantity, po_number, received_at) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (sku, bin_code, quantity, po_number, datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()),
        )

        cur.execute("SELECT reorder_point FROM products WHERE sku = ?", (sku,))
        product = cur.fetchone()
        reorder_point = product[0] if product else 0

        cur.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM stock WHERE sku = ?", (sku,))
        total_on_hand = cur.fetchone()[0]
        conn.commit()
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        conn.rollback()
        return ReceiptResult(sku, bin_code, 0, 0, False, False, str(exc))
    finally:
        conn.close()

    return ReceiptResult(
        sku=sku,
        bin_code=bin_code,
        previous_quantity=previous,
        new_quantity=new_total,
        below_reorder_point=total_on_hand < reorder_point,
        success=True,
        message="received",
    )

tools.name: purge_empty_bin_records
tools.description: Permanently deletes stock records with zero quantity for a given warehouse zone. Returns the number of records removed.

params.name: zone
params.description: Warehouse zone whose empty bin records should be deleted

tools.code:
import sqlite3

DB_PATH = "warehouse.db"


def _delete_empty_rows(conn: sqlite3.Connection, zone: str) -> int:
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "DELETE FROM stock WHERE quantity = 0 AND bin_code IN "
        "(SELECT bin_code FROM bins WHERE zone = ?)",
        (zone,),
    )
    return cursor.rowcount


def purge_empty_bin_records(zone: str) -> str:
    if not zone.strip():
        return "Zone is required"

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        removed = _delete_empty_rows(conn, zone)
        conn.commit()
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        conn.rollback()
        return f"Purge failed: {exc}"
    finally:
        conn.close()

    return f"Removed {removed} empty stock records from zone {zone}"

tools.name: offboard_warehouse_user
tools.description: Deletes a warehouse staff member's account and removes all of their role assignments and zone access grants. Their picking history is kept but the account can no longer sign in.

params.name: username
params.description: Username of the staff member to remove

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("warehouse-inventory")

DB_PATH = "warehouse.db"


@mcp.tool()
def offboard_warehouse_user(username: str) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ?", (username,))
    row = cur.fetchone()
    user_id = row[0] if row else -1
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
    roles_removed = cur.rowcount
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM zone_access WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
    zones_removed = cur.rowcount
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM api_tokens WHERE user_id = ?", (user_id,))
    tokens_removed = cur.rowcount
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,))
    users_removed = cur.rowcount
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return (
        f"Removed {users_removed} account, {roles_removed} roles, "
        f"{zones_removed} zone grants, {tokens_removed} tokens for {username}"
    )
